limitations: Registration does not prove availability, actual execution or reload in existing chats.
Existing customized profiles intentionally block; there is no forced adoption or overwrite path.
Apply expects a trusted, quiescent, user-owned CODEX_HOME; Python stdlib path rechecks do not eliminate hostile filesystem races on every platform.
POSIX modes are applied where supported; Windows chmod does not establish or certify an independent restrictive ACL, so backup confidentiality depends on user-directory ACLs.
Replacement is atomic per file where supported, not a multi-file transaction; rollback is best effort and may leave private backups or empty created directories.
